# A Delicate Balance

## Too Little. Too Much.

A healthy body constantly balances two opposing processes.

| Cell Division | Programmed Cell Death |
|--------------|-----------------------|
| Produces new cells | Removes old or damaged cells |
| Enables growth and repair | Maintains healthy tissues |

Too little cell division slows growth and healing.

Too little cell death, or uncontrolled cell division, can lead to diseases such as cancer.

Life depends on keeping both processes in balance.
